sentences.en: Frontline workers bear the brunt of the pandemic’s risk.

sentences.en: Yanni was sent straight to the frontline.
sentences.zh: 雅尼被直接派到了前线。

sentences.en: The journalist went to the frontline to report on the conflict.
sentences.zh: 记者前往前线报道冲突情况。
